route_selection: only route among three transport-live candidates whose frozen format canary returned exact JSON with state_patch and action
ordering: rotating interleave at every case step

exclusions.reason: zero completed three-arm cases; thresholds are null

second_pilot_rule: one full rerun only; if no completed three-arm case remains, publish availability/measurement-path blocker and do not invent thresholds

threshold_formula.minimum_total_token_saving: maximum completed-case relative absolute append-vs-append_repeat total-token difference
threshold_formula.quality_noninferiority_margin: maximum completed-case absolute append-vs-append_repeat field-score difference
